title: Grateful Dead Live at Bayfront Center on 1988-10-15
lineage: Nak MR-2 -> Behringer DI-800 DI-Box; Mains balanced -> Behringer MDX4600 Pro-XL Composer - > Sidechain Looped; Behringer Ultragraph Pro -> Behringer Ultrafex Pro -> Presonus Tube Pre-Amp -> BBE 882i -> DBX 231 EQ -> FW-410 -> Appogee SPDIF Cable -> M-Audio 1010LT -> wavelab @24/96
source: Nak100's -> Sony D-6  (Marantz PMD43x was lead deck)

ai_review.summary: Decent audience recording captures a solid set with standout performances of Sugaree, Blow Away, and a smoking Smokestack Lightning.
ai_review.review: The audience tape does a respectable job despite the arena’s tricky acoustics, delivering clear enough sound to enjoy the night.  Fans highlight Jerry’s vocal on Sugaree, the powerful Blow Away, an energetic Drums/Space, and a particularly hot transition from Truckin’ into Smokestack Lightning, while the second‑set flow is praised for its beautiful Stella moment.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical praise (high show quality) combined with a decent but not pristine audience recording yields an overall rating in the 4‑star range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent audience tape; arena acoustics introduce some coloration but overall clarity is sufficient for listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set II opens strong and builds into an energetic second half; transitions (especially Truckin' → Smokestack) are highlighted as fluid and exciting.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Nice vocal moments on Sugaree, with emotional delivery noted by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums/Space segment described as lots of fun and a highlight of the show.
